name: Oyako Ryoujoku Maid Kissa
source:
There is a small cafe. One day, the cafe is renovated and opened. As a matter of fact, Kenji, the main character, planned to change the cafe and collect customers by giving physical services without telling Ryoko, an owner of the cafe, and Megumi, Ryoko's daughter, about it. Just one day before its opening, he tells them about it and they agree to it. Like this, the cafe opens....

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20090116165518/http://www.erogeshop.com:80/product_info.php/products_id/1011956]Eroge Shop[/url]]
translation:
有一个小咖啡馆。有一天，咖啡馆重新装修并开业。事实上，主人公贤二并没有告诉咖啡馆老板凉子和凉子的女儿惠美，而是计划改变咖啡馆，通过实体服务来吸引顾客。就在开业前一天，他告诉了他们这件事，他们同意了。就这样，咖啡馆开业了……

[来自[url=https://web.archive.org/web/20090116165518/http://www.erogeshop.com:80/product_info.php/products_id/1011956]工口游戏商店[/url]]
